task.title: Using Duo Push Multifactor Authentication
task.shortdesc: Using Duo multifactor authentication (MFA) at NC State. Duo ensures that all individuals affiliated with the university are protected from unauthorized access to an NC State unity account.

taskbody.prereq: You must have Duo downloaded onto a personal device before using Duo.
taskbody.context: NC State uses Duo as its MFA system that works to authenticate Unity ID logins. You can authenticate through Duo using Duo Push on a mobile device.

step.cmd: Enter your Unity ID and password.

step.stepresult:
The window in Figure 1 will appear asking the user to navigate to the Duo app to verify the push notification. Figure 1: Duo Push Authentication Pop-Up
NC State Shibboleth login screen asking the user to check for a Duo Push notification

step.cmd: Navigate to the Duo app on your mobile device.
step.stepresult:
The Duo app will ask the user if they are logging into Shibboleth MFA as seen in Figure 2. Figure 2: Approval Screen in the Duo Mobile App
Duo Mobile app screen showing login request details with Deny and Approve buttons

info.note: Do not approve any Duo requests that were not made by you. If you suspect someone is attempting to access your NC State account, report the incident to NC State's cybersecurity team.
